quotes.quote: Clean reads were aligned to the mouse genome GRCm38.83 using STAR. The expression of the

transcript was calculated by FPKM (Fragments Per Kilobase of exon model per million mapped reads). The thresholds for determining differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were P < 0.05, and an absolute fold change ≥ 2.
For paired analysis, human head and neck cancer data were obtained from GSE179730 .

G1.rationale: The principal results include computational analyses (DEGs, pathway enrichment, hypoxia/angiogenesis scores) on RNA-seq data that a third party can re-run from deposited expression data.

G2.rationale: A principal quantitative result is the hypoxia/angiogenesis/Tip-like score change in the GSE179730 paired head-and-neck cancer dataset (Fig. 2d,e), which is the human computational target tied to the deposit.

G3.rationale: The deposit file GSE179730_RNAseq-combinedCPM.txt.gz is the expression input (CPM matrix) used to compute the hypoxia/angiogenesis scores, not an output of the target analysis.

quotes.quote: Hypoxia scores were calculated using mRNA-based signatures as previously described [ 30 ]. We analysed hypoxia and angiogenesis using Seigneuric, Buffa, Winter, West,

and Ragnum hypoxia signatures, Tian angiogenesis signatures, and Tip-like cell signatures [ 29 , 31 – 35 ]. In head and neck cancer ( GSE179730 ), anti-PD-1 (nivolumab) therapy decreased the hypoxia score, whereas the Tian angiogenesis score and Tip-like cell score were upregulated by anti-PD-1 (Fig. 2d, e ).

G4.rationale: The paper cites published signatures and prior methods but does not give the exact gene lists, scoring formula, normalization, or paired-test details, so implementation is only partly specified.

specification.input_notes: GEO accession GSE179730; the deposit lists a single file GSE179730_RNAseq-combinedCPM.txt.gz (combined CPM expression matrix). The paper does not state the exact GEO sample subset or the pre/post nivolumab pairing labels; these must be taken from the GEO series metadata.

leakage_files.name: GSE179730_RNAseq-combinedCPM.txt.gz
leakage_files.reason: This is the analysis input (expression matrix), not a leakage file; however, if the deposit also contained per-sample score tables or processed result tables they would be leakage. The listing contains only this file, which is required input, so no listed file is a leakage file.

specification.comparison_metric: Recompute the hypoxia, Tian angiogenesis, and Tip-like cell scores for the GSE179730 paired pre/post anti-PD-1 samples and compare the direction and magnitude of change to the reported Fig. 2d,e result.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split; scores compared within the displayed rounding bin of the figure, and paired comparisons by the same two-tailed Student's t-test at reported precision.
specification.specification_gaps: Exact gene lists and weights for each signature; score normalization/centering method; which GSE179730 samples constitute the paired pre/post nivolumab set; handling of missing genes; whether scores are z-scored per signature; exact statistical test and multiple-testing correction for Fig. 2d,e.

alternatives_considered.candidate: Tumor growth curves / tumor weight in LLC and 4T1 models (Fig. 1d,e,g,i)
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: These are in vivo experimental measurements, not computations on the deposited GSE179730 data; the deposit does not contain the mouse tumor measurements.

alternatives_considered.candidate: DEGs and pathway enrichment in mouse tumors (Fig. 4b-d)
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: The mouse RNA-seq raw data are not in the listed deposit (only GSE179730 human data are listed), so inputs are not deposited.
